### Project / state read

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `list_projects` | List all projects with todo/plan/milestone counts. Start here. |
| `get_project` | Full project record by slug or id. |
| `list_todos` | Todos for a project, filterable by status. |
| `list_plans` | Plans for a project, filterable by status. |
| `get_plan` | Plan detail including markdown body from disk. |
| `list_milestones` | Roadmap milestones; include_pinned eager-loads pinned items. |
| `list_plan_revisions` | Revision history for a plan, newest-first. |
| `list_brainstorm_graph` | M7 brainstorm canvas (deprecated). Use list_thoughts for v2. |
| `list_thoughts` | Brainstorm v2: list atomic thoughts for a project. |
| `get_thought` | Brainstorm v2: a thought plus its inbound and outbound relations. |

### Plan write

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `create_plan` | Write markdown plan + insert Plan row atomically. |
| `update_plan` | Partial update: title / status / body / context. |
| `link_plan_to_todos` | Link a plan to todos. Idempotent. |
| `pin_plan_to_milestone` | Pin a plan to a roadmap milestone. Idempotent. |
| `complete_plan` | Mark plan accepted (work shipped). Idempotent. |
| `archive_plan` | Mark plan archived (stale/superseded). Idempotent. |

### Todo write

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `create_todo` | Create a new todo for a project. |
| `update_todo` | Update a todo's text and/or status. |
| `start_todo` | Transition a todo to in_progress. |
| `pin_todo_to_milestone` | Pin a todo to a roadmap milestone. Idempotent. |

### Brainstorm v2 — thoughts

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `create_thought` | Add a thought to a project's ongoing brainstorm. |
| `update_thought` | Partial update of a thought; status='closed' soft-retires. |
| `delete_thought` | Hard-delete a thought; cascades incident relations only. |
| `link_thoughts` | Directed relation between two thoughts (kind: relates_to | builds_on | contradicts | supersedes). |
| `unlink_thoughts` | Delete a relation by id. |
| `promote_thoughts_to_plan` | Atomically create a Plan + stamp contributing thoughts promoted. |
| `promote_thoughts_to_todos` | Atomically create N Todos + stamp contributing thoughts promoted (anchored to first todo). |
| `promote_thoughts_to_milestone` | Atomically create a Milestone + stamp contributing thoughts promoted. |

### Legacy brainstorm canvas (M7 — deprecated)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `create_brainstorm_node` | Add a node to the canvas. Prefer create_thought for new work. |
| `create_brainstorm_edge` | Connect two nodes. Prefer link_thoughts for new work. |
| `update_brainstorm_node` | Update a node's label/kind/content. |
| `delete_brainstorm_node` | Delete a node; cascades its edges. |
